definition: הָרָן proper name, masculine ( mountaineer ; i.e. mountain-people (or land)? compare Di Gen 11:27 ); — 1. son of Terah\, brother of Abram and father of Lot Gen 11:27 (twice in verse); Gen 11:31 (all P ), v Gen 11:28 ( J ); also father of Milcah (Nahor's wife) & Iscah v Gen 11:29 ( J ). 2. a Levite (Gershonite) 1Chr 23:9 . — On הָרָן in proper name, of a location see below בית הרם , p. 111.

הָרָן proper name, masculine (mountaineer; i.e. mountain-people (or land)? compare Di Gen 11:27); —

1. son of Terah\, brother of Abram and father of Lot Gen 11:27 (twice in verse); Gen 11:31 (all P), vGen 11:28 (J); also father of Milcah (Nahor's wife) & Iscah vGen 11:29 (J).
2. a Levite (Gershonite) 1Chr 23:9. — On הָרָן in proper name, of a location see below בית הרם, p. 111.
